scope: Arbitrary finite beta residual sums under an explicit normalized O(n) height budget, plus exact unequal-degree boundary-unit lift and annihilator-resultant criteria against Item265 de-overlapped targets

claims.label: PROVED
claims.claim: For every finite nonzero integer sum R=sum T_j, with B=gcd_j|T_j| and every target Q, the normalized cancellation quotient gcd(Q,R)/gcd(Q,B) divides R/B.
claims.evidence: report Section 2, exact primewise valuation identity
claims.scope_limit: R must be nonzero to supply a height certificate

claims.label: PROVED_SCOPED_CAPACITY_BOUND
claims.claim: The explicit assumption log(sum_j|T_j|/B)=O(n) gives log of the entire sum-only quotient O(n)=o(n log n), with no sparsity or degree restriction.
claims.scope_limit: the terms must be specified independently of target factorization for capacity admission

claims.label: PROVED_ACTUAL_TARGET_IMPLICATION
claims.claim: If Q divides R, then Q/gcd(Q,B) divides R/B and has logarithmic height O(n) under the normalized conservative-height hypothesis.
claims.scope_limit: the common baseline gcd(Q,B) remains the Item282 product channel

claims.label: PROVED_DEOVERLAP
claims.claim: All cancellation statements hold for every Q dividing q_n/gcd(q_n,D_m), so the Item265 two-copy clearing reservoir is removed before capacity is measured.
claims.scope_limit: the transverse matching correlation remains open

claims.label: PROVED
claims.claim: For unequal Casoratian degrees k_j, the scalar sum reduces exactly to u^k0 F(u) modulo Q, where u=-q_(n+1)^2 is a unit and F(U)=sum c_j A_j U^(k_j-k0).
claims.evidence: report Section 4 and the one-factor Casoratian congruence
claims.scope_limit: evaluation at a moving unit still requires an integer lift or algebraic relation for a height argument

claims.label: PROVED_CONDITIONAL_CLOSURE
claims.claim: Any integer lift v congruent to u modulo Q with nonzero evaluated residual and normalized evaluated l1 height O(n) gives an O(n) sum-only cancellation ceiling.
claims.scope_limit: no such uniformly small actual-family lift is proved

claims.label: PROVED_SCOPED_HEIGHT_BARRIER
claims.claim: For a genuinely nonhomogeneous sum, the canonical lift v=-q_(n+1)^2 has normalized conservative height at least 2 log q_(n+1)=2n log n+O(n).
claims.scope_limit: this does not exclude a different small representative or algebraic relation

claims.label: PROVED
claims.claim: Multiplying every degree-k_j scalar term by C_1^(K-k_j) gives a new homogeneous sum with residual F(1) at no continuant cost.
claims.evidence: report Section 7; P_1=1 and C_1 congruent to u modulo Q
claims.scope_limit: this changes the original F(u) collision and gives no universal transfer of divisibility

claims.label: PROVED_RESULTANT_CLOSURE
claims.claim: If monic M satisfies M(u)=0 modulo Q, the sum-only quotient divides Res(M,F/B); a nonzero resultant of logarithmic height O(n) gives an O(n) cancellation ceiling.
claims.scope_limit: a zero resultant is an identity branch and supplies no nonzero height certificate

claims.label: PROVED_SCOPED_HEIGHT_BARRIER
claims.claim: The tautological annihilator U+q_(n+1)^2 has coefficient height 2n log n+O(n), and coefficient height alone cannot control a moving-unit evaluation when degree is uncharged.
claims.scope_limit: no general impossibility for new low-height annihilators is claimed

claims.label: OPEN_EXACT_MISSING_LEMMA
claims.claim: The first admissible nonhomogeneous construction is either a factorization-independent small unit lift with O(n) normalized evaluated height, or a factorization-independent monic annihilator with nonzero O(n)-height resultant.
claims.scope_limit: neither construction is currently known for the actual family

claims.label: EXACT_FINITE_ONLY
claims.claim: The deterministic checker replays arbitrary-term quotients, actual unequal-degree boundary reductions, unit lifts, homogenization non-transfer, resultants, and zero-resultant identities.
claims.scope_limit: the rows are exact algebraic witnesses only; no prime census or asymptotic extrapolation is performed

claims.label: PROVED_BOOKING_DECISION
claims.claim: Every closed additive branch has zero normalized rate, while the actual low-height invariant and the common product baseline remain open; booking is zero.
claims.scope_limit: Route 1 and every conclusion about e+pi remain open
